name: create_reminder
description: Create reminder(s) or calendar event(s) that sync to Google Calendar and trigger TTS notifications. Use when user says: 'remind me', 'set a reminder', 'add to calendar', 'schedule', 'create event', 'calendar event', etc. IMPORTANT: Supports MULTI-DAY patterns in a SINGLE call - 'next 5 days at 2pm', 'for the next 5 days at 2pm', '5 days in a row at 2pm' will create 5 individual reminders automatically. Also supports: 'in 30 minutes', 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'every Wednesday at 2pm' (weekly), 'every month on the 10th' (monthly), 'every day at 2pm' (daily recurring). Syncs to Google Calendar.

description.description: Optional additional details about the reminder

when.description: Natural time expression. Multi-day: 'next 5 days at 2pm', 'for the next 5 days at 2pm', '5 days in a row at 2pm' (creates multiple reminders). One-time: 'in 30 minutes', 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'at 5pm'. Recurring: 'every day at 2pm', 'every Wednesday at 2pm', 'every month on the 10th'. Use the user's natural phrasing.
